title: Walleyedan's Guide Service

services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: The ice fishing season around the Brainerd Lakes Area typically starts around the first week in December (give or take) and runs through March. So whether you are looking for early ice walleyes or late ice eel pout or pan fish, we’ve got you covered. Whatever you choose to do, we will keep you safe and warm! The season starts off on foot once we get 4 solid inches of ice. Once we have 8 inches, the SnoBear comes out of hibernation. And then, out come the bigger houses! If you haven’t been on a guided SnoBear trip, you might want to give it a whirl! I can pick you up at your house, resort or meet you at a landing somewhere in the area. You can go from the comforts of your home or vehicle
